01 / ERP

A shared foundation for your operations.

Sales & purchasing

Customers, suppliers, orders, deliveries, receipts, invoices, credit notes and payments.

Products & inventory

Product catalogue, warehouses, stock movements and quantity tracking.

Finance & accounting

Cash management, double-entry bookkeeping, payment tracking and exports.

Your organisation

CRM, human resources, configurable payroll, projects and manufacturing to suit your needs.

Documents & data

PDF documents, Excel imports with previews and data exports.

Access & traceability

Roles, permissions, two-factor authentication and an operations audit trail.

02 / WINDOWS & WEB

An installation that fits the way you work.

Windows, even offline

A standalone application with a local database, encrypted backups, restoration and offline activation.

Shared server

A server edition for browser access on your network or dedicated hosting. The public SaaS service is not yet available.

Multiple workstations

Connect to a reference server on your local network or over the Internet. In version 0.5, conflicts require manual reconciliation and snapshots are limited to 24 MiB.

A licence that fits your project.

A local perpetual licence or a monthly / annual subscription: we define users, modules and support together. Perpetual licences include twelve months of maintenance; the acquired version remains usable after maintenance expires.

Version 0.5 is offered as a guided pilot. Tax, accounting and payroll settings need validation for your business. The demonstration helps assess whether the software fits your workflows.

Let’s take a closer look at your business.

Tell us about your company, the number of workstations and the features you need. We will contact you to arrange a demonstration.
